name: Production User Acceptance, Edge-Case & Stress Certification

T7_1_startup_and_load.findings: Application loads cleanly on localhost:8000, header displays Stage 5.3 Certified and Fri 13:00-18:00 Closed badges, 0 console errors, 0 console warnings.

T7_2_student_section_view.findings: Section grid verified across multiple sections (BIC_ TIGERS_2024, AIML_TIGERS_2025). 2-hour labs span seamlessly, Friday slots 4-8 are visibly empty displaying 'No Classes Post-Lunch', 0 section overlaps.

T7_3_faculty_view.findings: Faculty grid verified across multiple professors (Dr Harshavardhan Reddy Kalluru, Dr Riaz Shaik). 0 faculty collisions, contiguous labs, Friday post-lunch clean empty state.

T7_4_room_view.findings: Room grid verified for theory halls (Room 302, C-202) and specialized labs (Advanced Electrical & Electronics Lab Room No-C105). 0 room clashes, 595 rooms frozen, 0 Friday post-lunch room bookings.

T7_5_master_register.findings: Master register lists all 598 scheduled events. Filtering by day, type, room, and keyword operates without state leakage. Reset button cleanly restores full 598 events.

T7_6_search_edge_cases.findings: Search tested with exact subjects, partial substrings, faculty surnames, section IDs, room IDs, mixed-case, whitespace, and non-matching queries. Returns clean non-breaking empty state on no match.

T7_7_event_detail_modal.findings: Detailed inspection modal tested for theory, labs, shared, multi-faculty, and NO_ROOM events. Displays complete metadata, supports Enter key invocation and Escape key dismissal.

T7_8_no_room_edge_cases.findings: All 3 pinned NO_ROOM events (#595, #596, #597) verified. Display explicit NO_ROOM tag without physical room allocation; day and slot positions 100% preserved.

T7_9_lab_integrity.findings: All 75 labs verified to have duration 2, occupying two contiguous slots in a single room, with 0 labs crossing Friday slot 3 into slot 4.

T7_10_shared_event_integrity.findings: All 38 synchronized shared events verified. Synchronized cohorts and multi-faculty assignments reflected without artificial duplicate rows.

T7_11_split_event_integrity.findings: All 6 nested/split subgroup events (BIC__TIGERS_2025: #209, #214, #215 and DS__TIGERS_2025: #220, #231, #235) verified as independent sessions without parent conflict.

T7_12_friday_closed_state.findings: Friday slots 0-3 contain allowed classes (22, 28, 24, 3 event-hours). Friday slots 4-8 contain exactly 0 teaching hours across all sections, faculty, and rooms.

T7_13_navigation_and_state.findings: Rapid switching across all 5 navigation views (Section, Faculty, Room, Master, Metrics) produces zero view desynchronization, zero filter corruption, and zero stale state.

T7_14_responsive_layout.findings: Tested at 1920x1080, 1440x900, 1280x720, and 1024x768. Layout remains stable with zero text clipping, no horizontal page overflow, and crisp grid alignment.

T7_15_keyboard_accessibility.findings: Full keyboard navigation supported: Tab focus ring visible on all interactive elements, Enter opens event details, Escape closes modal.

T7_16_print_and_export.findings: CSV export contains exactly 598 rows with 100% field parity against JSON. Print stylesheet tested via @media print omitting UI chrome.

T7_17_black_box_data_integrity.findings: Independent reconstruction of production_schedule.json confirms exact match with UI counters: 598 events, 748 student-hrs, 981 faculty-hrs, 0 Friday post-lunch hours.

T7_18_refresh_persistence_and_runtime_st.findings: Repeated reload, view switching, filter toggling, and modal interactions produce zero console errors, zero warnings, and zero memory degradation.

T7_19_final_regression.findings: All file hashes unchanged, original FET HTML files untouched, 0 collisions, 0 leave clashes, 0 discrepancies.
